name: On foot at first light
led_by: A Maasai guide from the camp
live: The grass is still wet and the river is still in mist. Your guide kneels by a fresh track and reads the night that just passed, animal by animal.
good_to_know: Comfortable walking shoes and a warm layer. The pace is gentle and set by the group.
alt: A guide and a guest standing among the rocks of the Mara River
